_comment: Each class of characters the engine reads by its purpose, defined once and read by
filmkit.languages in Python and by scripts.mjs in Node. A class holds either code-point
ranges, each as FIRST-LAST in hexadecimal, or the characters it names. The scripts are
Unicode's scripts Han and Latin, as Node 26.13.1's ICU reads their Script property; a language declares
the scripts it writes by these names.

line-closing.purpose: marks that close what precedes them, which a line may not open on

line-opening.purpose: marks that open what follows them, which a line may not end on

semicolons.purpose: marks that end a clause without ending its sentence

sentence-closers.purpose: closing quotes and brackets that follow a sentence end and belong to its sentence

quotation-marks.purpose: quotation marks, which are not pauses of their own

clause-marks.purpose: full-width marks that close a clause

enumeration-marks.purpose: marks between the items of a list

phrase-breaks.purpose: Latin marks that break a phrase inside a sentence

cue-boundaries.purpose: stops and colons, which close a caption cue

word-edge-marks.purpose: marks an aligned word may carry around its letters
